_about: Marker positions for README.md. x/y are GTA VI in-game metres in the gtadb.org coordinate system (x east, y north). precision: 'landmark' = a named point in the gtadb.org landmarks data (CC BY 4.0); 'district' = centre of the named district (median of gtadb landmarks there, or the label on the Visit Leonida map); 'approx' = placed from a guide's description such as 'NE Port Gellhorn docks', accurate to a few hundred metres at best. null = no source gives a usable location.
